pages.text: $(italic)Sturdy, slow and made for underground work. Dwarves excel in Tiers 1 and 2, when mining and forging dominate.$()$(br2)$(bold)Mining Speed$(): +25% on stone and ore, dropping to +15% outside the Overworld.$(br2)$(bold)Fire Resistance$(): permanent fire resistance IV. Lava does not burn you, and Blazes deal 40% less damage.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Sturdy$(): +8% armor effectiveness from heavy armor (iron, steel, diamond and netherite only).$(br2)$(bold)Slow$(): -10% movement speed, permanently: the cost of being built like a boulder.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Paladin or Artificer, then go strip a cave. Your +25% pick pays from minute one.$()
